newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Elektrowatt rises on sale rumours.
newsitem.headline: Elektrowatt rises on sale rumours.

text.p: Shares in Swiss industrial and utility group Elektrowatt rose on Thursday on speculation that bank group CS Holding would sell at least part of its 44.9 percent Elektrowatt stake by year's end.
Elektrowatt bearer shares were higher by six Swiss francs or 1.2 percent at 513 francs at midday, while the blue-chip Swiss Market Index eased 0.07 percent to 3,855.0.
Traders said there was growing belief on the market in rumours that CS Holding would act soon on its long-standing plan to sell the Elektrowatt stake.
"Where there's smoke, there's fire," one trader said.
A CS Holding spokesman declined comment, saying the bank group never talks about market rumours.
CS Holding has said it wants to get rid of its non-core businesses including Elektrowatt but has not named a deadline, saying only that the price and purchaser must be right.
Swiss media have said CS Holding has set a deadline of December 16 for offers for Elektrowatt, either as a whole or more likely for its electrical utility and power trading business.
The business newspaper HandelsZeitung said December 16 was the deadline for deciding on offers, but industry officials close to the bidding said this date was only the cut-off for receiving offers.

Elektrowatt announced on November 29 that it would spin off its utilities business next year as a separate company to be named Watt AG, with CS Holding keeping a stake of 44.9 percent in both Elektrowatt and Watt.
